title: Magnetic enhancement of high-entropy oxide electrocatalysts for high areal-energy rechargeable zinc air batteries
content:
Energy Adv., 2025, 4,1229-1240
DOI: 10.1039/D5YA00091B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Ernst H. Hechter, Aderemi B. Haruna, Xiao-Yu Yang, Maxwell W. Terban, Héctor D. Abruña, Dean H. Barrett, Kenneth I. Ozoemena
High-entropy spinel oxide ((CuCoFeMnNi)3O4) has been synthesized and a magnetic field was applied to enhance its electrocatalytic oxygen reactions, dramatically improving the power profile of rechargeable zinc–air battery cells.
